definitions.explanation: Refers to the original, inherent, or proper state or nature of something, or how something should be.

examples.japanese: {本来|ほんらい}の{目的|もくてき}を{忘|わす}れないでください。
examples.english: Please don't forget the original purpose.

examples.japanese: {本来|ほんらい}なら{今日|きょう}{届|とど}くはずだった。
examples.english: It was supposed to arrive today originally.

examples.japanese: この{言葉|ことば}の{本来|ほんらい}の{意味|いみ}を{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: I looked up the original meaning of this word.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{本来|ほんらい}の (original; inherent)
・{本来|ほんらい}なら (originally; properly speaking)

SIMILAR:
・{元々|もともと} (originally - more casual)
・{元来|がんらい} (by nature - more formal)
